meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Runs maximum-saturation research with a cooperating team, claim-graph gating, and a cited, QA'd deliverable. Use when the user explicitly asks for research or a deep investigation, including any 'ulw' research wording.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 组织协作团队跑多轮调研,产出带引用、经质检的研究报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你需要一份结论有据可查、经得起追问的深度调研报告。
copy.tagline_en: Run multi-round team research and get a cited, QA-checked report
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a deep research report where every claim is cited and verified.

howto.what: 它会组建一支研究团队并行铺开搜集资料,对争议结论做交叉辩论,并用跑代码来验证,最终交付每句话都带引用或验证证据的成果(默认 PDF + DOCX)。
howto.when: 只有你明确点名研究任务时才接管:说出 “ulw-research”、任何带 “ulw” 的研究说法,或直接要求深度调查等;普通提问和调试不触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-research 深挖这个议题,给我带引用的报告
say.note: 它会先问你要 PDF 还是 DOCX 等格式

say.text: 用 ulw-research 调查 X,让团队辩论争议点
say.note: 争议主张会进辩论轮并用代码验证

say.text: 用 ulw-research 以 Markdown 做这份深度调查
say.note: 最终材料按你的格式回答产出

howto.what_en: It stands up a cooperating research team, fans out over sources, cross-debates contested claims, proves disputed ones by running code, and delivers a synthesis where every claim carries a citation or proof (default PDF + DOCX).
howto.when_en: Only when you explicitly ask: "ulw-research", any "ulw" research wording, or a deep/ultra-precise investigation in any language. Ordinary questions and debugging do not trigger it.

say_en.text: Run ulw-research on this topic and give me a cited report
say_en.note: It first asks which format you want (e.g. PDF or DOCX)

say_en.text: Use ulw-research to investigate X and debate the contested points
say_en.note: Contested claims get a debate round and code proof

say_en.text: Run ulw-research as a Markdown deep investigation
say_en.note: Your format answer sets the final materials
